summary: Iter 50 — P5 tranche 5 (riders/deliveries/sessions/GPS extraction). Ran 28 pytest cases covering all 15 endpoints in routers/riders.py plus RBAC and regression. All 28 PASSED. New router cleanly wired, models AssignIn/SessionIn/ReconcileIn/RiderLocationIn validated, RBAC enforced (sales 403 on assign/suggest-split/create-session; rider only self can POST /rider/position; rider_id in body is ignored — server uses token identity). Reconcile correctly requires PIN gérante for collected=true (400 if missing, 403 if invalid, 200 with approver recorded). Rider-scoped /deliveries confirmed. Regression smoke on /auth/me, /attendance/me, /products, /orders, /cash-sessions, /pos/holds, /pos/pin-authorize all green. /orders/{oid}/status still served from server.py (line 888) as intended.

minor.issue: `satisfaction` field uses random.uniform(4.1, 4.8) instead of real review avg — non-deterministic, misleading for UI.
No RBAC — any authenticated role (incl. rider/sales/customer-staff) can view live positions of all riders. Should likely be admin/manager only.
No explicit role check — any authenticated user can write to rider_locations/rider_positions keyed by their own user.id. Harmless but should restrict to role=='rider'.
No RBAC — a rider can read scores/KPIs of OTHER riders by passing another rid. Should restrict to self or admin/manager.
No rider scoping — a rider can list sessions of any rider by passing rider_id query. Should auto-scope when role=='rider'.
`amount` is cast via float(body.amount) without clamping; negative amounts accepted and recorded as écart. Minor validation gap.

action_items: (Optional, security) Add RBAC guards to GET /riders/locations, GET /riders/{rid}/{score,reviews,kpis} (self or admin/manager), and auto-scope GET /delivery-sessions when caller role=='rider'.
(Optional) Replace random satisfaction in /riders/{rid}/kpis with real review rating average.
